boy.qwen_voice: A 7-year-old boy with a bright, clear child's voice, quick and dry, a cheeky little deadpan, never shouting unless the note says so, like a witty kid host.

uncle.qwen_voice: A huge, warm, middle-aged man with a deep, rich, theatrical voice, a little husky, operatic and over the top when grand, tiny and wheezy when defeated, quiet and sincere when moved.

grandma.qwen_voice: An elderly woman, a village cook, flat, dry and unimpressed, a little raspy, brisk, kind underneath, never raising her voice.

narrator.qwen_voice: A huge, booming, epic anime-trailer narrator voice, deep and thunderous and theatrical, with slow dramatic pauses.
